recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If implementers need eld-23 to exempt differential-only binding-strength changes, raise a focused FHIR-I issue to decide whether the rule should move exclusively to StructureDefinition.snapshot.element or gain a context-sensitive exception.
issue_request: FHIR-26892 was Published with resolution Persuasive. It requested an invariant preventing ElementDefinition.binding from containing only a strength and no target, requiring either binding.valueSet or binding.description when a binding is present.
initial_application: The StructureDefinition source already had snapshot-scoped sdf-10 in the 2021 source rework/R4B history, and commit 8c5984683a9fd3c608c393868231833ffd36f89d later added ElementDefinition.binding invariant 23 with expression description.exists() or valueSet.exists() to source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml. That application is contained in v5.0.0.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and Jira comment noted that differentials can change only binding.strength and inherit valueSet/description into the generated snapshot. Current StructureDefinition source keeps sdf-10 on snapshot.element and does not add that resource-level constraint to differential.element. Later FHIR-48325 added descriptive BindingStrength and a valueSet-omission invariant without superseding the FHIR-26892 target rule; its reconciliation is already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. source/fhir.ini marks ElementDefinition as normative and StructureDefinition as active, and current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml plus source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml already represent the requested rule. Narrowing or removing the published normative ElementDefinition invariant to create a differential exception would require a new work-group decision.

related_jiras.note: The RiskAssessment binding gap was cited as the motivating example of a binding with no target, but it is a separate CDS issue.
Later FHIR-I work added descriptive BindingStrength and a related invariant without reversing FHIR-26892; it is already represented on the combined branch.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue requesting that ElementDefinition.binding have either valueSet or description so a binding cannot have only strength and no target.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final in-scope R5 source requirement for the seed issue.

evidence_items.summary: The originating thread agreed that bindings should have valueSet or description while noting ambiguity about snapshot-only versus differential-only binding-strength changes.
evidence_items.learned: The differential concern is real context, but it was not enough evidence for an AutoFHIR source rewrite of the published normative invariant.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR-I minutes record a 12-0-0 motion to make the normative core change and fall back to best-practice only if ballot objections arose.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence supports keeping the substantive Error rule represented in current source.

evidence_items.summary: The FHIR-26892 implementation commit added ElementDefinition.binding invariant 23 with expression description.exists() or valueSet.exists().
evidence_items.learned: The explicit Jira-tagged application exists in source history and is contained in v5.0.0.

evidence_items.summary: ElementDefinition.binding has optional valueSet and description, and invariant 23 requires at least one of them when a binding exists.
evidence_items.learned: The target requirement requested by FHIR-26892 is present in the current authoritative datatype source.

evidence_items.summary: The active StructureDefinition resource source has sdf-10 on snapshot.element requiring binding valueSet or description, and no equivalent resource-level sdf-10 on differential.element.
evidence_items.learned: Current source includes the snapshot enforcement surface relevant to the Jira comment without adding that resource-level constraint to differentials.

evidence_items.summary: Later applied work added the descriptive BindingStrength code and an invariant omitting valueSet for descriptive bindings, and is already represented on the combined branch.
evidence_items.learned: Later binding policy refines description-only bindings but does not reverse the FHIR-26892 target invariant.
